method: top-down: required = minimum sustained throughput a unit/interface/port needs on the token critical path (with the overlap the compiled program allows) at the designed tok/s; designed from RTL/spec; measured from RTL benches where present; margin = (measured or designed) / required; flag margin < 1.1 (THIN = 1.0-1.1, GAP < 1.0, INFEASIBLE = structurally cannot reach). No fixed % of HBM peak (owner rule 2026-10-10 06:58).

hbm_compute: Method: required = the per-record price the schedule charges on the S2 critical path (each target is defined by those prices); designed = RTL structure (file:line) evaluated at the measured HBM first access 104 cycles (timing.MEAS hbm.first_access) and the bench VM RTT ~9.7 cycles (tb_hgi_sm_e2e case 5); measured = committed adapter/unit benches (results/rtl/hgi_adapters_20261009/benches) or e2e_calibration.

tok_s_if_as_designed changes ONE unit (the others at budget) by adding (designed-priced) x records to the S2 critical-path cycles; units are serial on the token path (busy shares above), overlap credit ignored -> slightly pessimistic for small deltas, irrelevant for the order-of-magnitude rows.

SM/ATT/HC are stubs in hgi_e2e (STATUS.md matrix); hgi-1010/g throughput benches (wt hgi-tput-{att,sm,qi}-1010) had no SM/ATT/HC results at audit time (only QDQ 8 rec 2,295 vs 168 priced). The ATT/HC/x-load magnitudes here are the first quantification.

Cross-ref hbm_datactl.json for the ATT single 32 B HBM lane / KV read, CP fetch, KVWB, weight-stream proxy, collectives, CG wake (not duplicated). From the RTL (ot_hgi_att_unit.sv:344-372) rows are also fetched strictly one at a time (wait hout==0 per row): ~111 cycles/row at L=104 -> Qwen ~913k cycles per 8,192-row record vs 660.1 priced (~9 tok/s); pipelined single lane ceiling ~164 tok/s. Compute-side ATT points kept here: VM scores client and the DS FP32-row price above HBM peak. HBM rows follow the owner rule (no 90% target; only real shortfalls). Biggest new structural gaps: (2) SM x-load is serial and not double-buffered (every SM record pays K/8 sectors through 4 single-outstanding VM clients) and does not exist for DS FP8/FP4; (3) HC/FUSED stage 20,480-word h through one VM client (G22 approved path 1,747.5 -> ~1,028); (4) multi-slot head STREAM is 1 beat/edge with no back-pressure.

The VM-lane fix proposed by hgi-1010/b (32 read + 32 write lanes, 1 sector/lane/cycle) would also close x-load, ATT scores, HC/FUSED h staging if those units are made lane clients; worth one owner decision.
Not in compute scope but seen: CP F5 one fetch sector in flight (hgi_e2e STATUS); DMA mover F6; ALL_GATHER 2.26x (known).
hbm_datactl: Tokens are a dependency chain (per_unit idle_true_dep dominates even in S0), so a unit is on the critical path whenever it runs; required = priced service.
Opportunities (not margin gaps): Qwen ARGMAX.LOCAL reads VM at 1 elem/cyc = 76,395 cyc (6.1%) + head_scale 76,503; a STREAM argmax (16/cyc) would cut ~72k cyc -> ~1,016 tok/s.
svc_kvs.json is the r16g svc stream bench; the r25 svc has not had a die-level KV / weight bandwidth bench.
